## J-lens basis status

DROPPED for this v5 execution (amendment v5.5). Qwen2.5-3B J-gram was infeasible on the laptop: fp32 backward peaked at 17.5 GB (over the 15 GB budget), and the bf16 run was killed after 98 min with no batch done. states_qwen.pt has no J-lens basis, so negotiate5 built only pca and random books. No jlens rows exist in any test file.
